ACTION 15 OF 32 · PHASE 04

Find grants, accelerators and capital pathways

Find suitable support, not just attractive grant headlines.

WHEN TO DO THISOnce you can explain use of funds, eligibility and delivery milestones.ESTIMATED WORK TIME30–60 min initially; revisit weekly
↗
Your one job

Find suitable support, not just attractive grant headlines.

01

Do this now

  1. 01

    Check official SBDC Bahamas announcements, relevant development institutions, chamber/newsletters and active accelerator websites.

  2. 02

    Search regional opportunities (CDB, CEDA and relevant funders) but verify country/sector eligibility on the original programme page.

  3. 03

    For each programme log amount or benefit, deadline, citizenship/entity requirements, documents, match funding and source checked date.

  4. 04

    Choose APPLY / PREPARE / WATCH / IGNORE. Prepare a reusable application folder without pretending a programme is open.

02

Copy this into ChatGPT

Replace anything in [square brackets] with your real business details. The prompt is a shortcut, not a substitute for the steps above.

READY-TO-USE PROMPT
Find current grants, financing schemes, accelerators, pitch competitions and partnership opportunities that may fit [BUSINESS] in [COUNTRY] and the Caribbean. Use official issuers as primary sources. For each, give issuing body, exact source URL, what is offered, location/sector rules, required stage/documents, current deadline and status (verified open / review / closed / watch). Mark any unknown. Explain the realistic fit and top action, not just a long list.
03

Finish with this

A shortlist of verified opportunities and an application document checklist.

Before moving on, check your work against the following:

  • Every opportunity has an original source
  • Eligibility and current open status are verified
  • Application effort is justified by fit
DON’T MAKE THIS MISTAKE

Publishing stale grants as currently available or applying solely because a title sounds relevant.

↗

Useful official references

SBDC Bahamas ↗
READY TO MOVE ON?

Price exceeds variable costs, capacity and cash needs are realistic, and at least one acquisition path can plausibly work.
